$comment: Source: CMHC Canadian Covered Bonds Registry page (https://www.cmhc-schl.gc.ca/professionals/project-funding-and-mortgage-financing/securitization/canadian-registered-covered-bonds/canadian-covered-bonds-registry). Field semantics were confirmed against the live registry table.
title: CMHC Canadian Covered Bonds Registry
description: JSON Schema for the CMHC registry of Canadian registered covered bond issuers. The registry lists each registered issuer, its business address, registration date, active/suspended status, the issuer's own covered-bond website, and a link to the CMHC page describing the issuer's registered program(s). Dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates and values are normalized rather than copied as formatted HTML.

sourceUrl.description: URL or path the registry was parsed from, when known.

issuers.description: One entry per issuer row in the registry table, in printed order.

name.description: Registered Issuer Name, e.g. 'Bank of Nova Scotia'.

businessAddress.description: Business Address exactly as printed, with whitespace normalized. The printed value contains line breaks and non-breaking spaces.

registrationDate.description: Date of Registration, e.g. '22 July 2013' on the page, normalized to '2013-07-22'.

status.description: Active (A) / Suspended (S) column. 'A' is normalized to 'active' and 'S' to 'suspended'.

websiteUrl.description: Href of the 'Link to Issuer's Registered Covered Bonds Website' cell. This is an external website, not a CMHC page.

programPage.description: Href of the 'Registered Programs' link. On the live CMHC site this is a site-relative path such as '/professionals/.../canadian-covered-bond-program-bank-of-nova-scotia'.
